items.what: The plan stops with a proposal, which names its own route: Defect in kb/reports/state/review/results/kb/theory/a-repeatable-operative-path-keeps-a-redesign-class-open-to-revision.md/kb/instructions/premise-decomposition-gate.md. Check 6 requires the successor and its authority path to remain addressable. The enclosed controller can halve a read-protected gain from 8 to 4 and then from 4 to 2 on overshoot. Later control cycles use each replacement, and the circuit can repeat the same revision from gain 4 even though the gain and its authority relation are unavailable for inspection. Check 1 also permits two readings with different verdicts for this case. The reviewer can identify the gain and its consumer from the design, while the updater targets a wired register without modeling that authority relation. Correcting those criteria changes the meaning or applicability of the six-check test relied on by kb/tags/reflection-README.md, kb/theory/axes-of-artifact-analysis.md, kb/theory/an-improvement-can-close-the-path-to-further-improvement.md, kb/theory/a-better-factory-claim-compares-operative-states.md, kb/theory/a-bootstrap-fits-the-bitter-lesson-only-if-learning-outgrows-it.md, kb/theory/evidence/six-reported-self-improvement-paths-expose-bounded-redesign-surfaces.md, kb/agentic-systems/reviews/agno-agentos.md. See kb/reports/state/review/runs/v2/revise/kb/theory/a-repeatable-operative-path-keeps-a-redesign-class-open-to-revision/20261120T144910Z/role. The separate causal claim that ADR 028 informed ADR 057 is unsupported by the cited records, as recorded in kb/reports/state/review/results/kb/theory/a-repeatable-operative-path-keeps-a-redesign-class-open-to-revision.md/semantic/grounding-alignment.md. Resolve it in the same commission. Use commonplace-revise rewrite NOTE --commission FILE, with the commission prepared using cp-skill-write-multistage.
